tagline: World's largest wholesale distributor of swimming pool supplies and equipment
hero_kpi_rationale: The pool and landscape sector is characterized by strong recurring demand for maintenance products and services. Approximately 64% of sales derive from maintenance and repair of existing installations, which generates predictable and non-discretionary revenue streams independent of economic cycles.

kpis.name: Recurring Sales Share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of sales from maintenance and minor repair of existing pool installations
kpis.description: The recurring sales share reflects continuous and non-discretionary demand for maintenance products and services on existing swimming pools, generating stable revenues independent of economic conditions
kpis.signal: Indicator of financial health and revenue stability

kpis.name: Sales Growth
kpis.description: Negative sales growth reflects decreased demand for new pool construction and renovations due to consumer discretionary spending pullback and elevated financing costs
kpis.signal: Indicator of market demand and economic conditions

kpis.name: Renovation Sales Share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of sales from pool remodeling, renovations and upgrades
kpis.description: The renovation sales share reflects demand for repairs, modernizations and upgrades of existing swimming pools, sensitive to economic conditions and real estate values
kpis.signal: Indicator of discretionary spending on pool improvements

kpis.name: New Pool Construction Sales Share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of sales from new pool construction projects
kpis.description: The new pool construction sales share represented approximately 14% of 2025 sales, declining due to reduced new pool unit construction from 62,000 to approximately 60,000 units
kpis.signal: Indicator of new pool unit demand

kpis.name: Number of Sales Centers
kpis.explanation: Total number of sales centers operated by the company
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, the company operated 456 sales centers strategically located in North America, Europe and Australia
kpis.signal: Indicator of geographic presence and market reach

kpis.name: Product Cost Inflation
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year percentage change in product input costs
kpis.description: Product cost inflation moderated to approximately 2 to 3% in 2025, including 1% impact from US tariffs, versus 1 to 2% expected in 2026
kpis.signal: Indicator of margin pressure and pricing power

kpis.name: In-ground Swimming Pools Installed Base
kpis.explanation: Estimated number of in-ground swimming pools in the United States
kpis.description: The installed base of in-ground swimming pools in the United States is estimated at 5.5 million units, providing a substantial customer base for maintenance, repair and renovation services
kpis.signal: Indicator of addressable market size and growth potential

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL across the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $5.289 billion in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Recurring Sales Share 2025
kpis.explanation: Percentage of sales from maintenance and minor repair of existing pool installations in 2025
kpis.description: In 2025, approximately 64% of sales derived from maintenance and minor repair of existing pool installations, reflecting continuous non-discretionary demand
kpis.signal: Indicator of financial health and revenue stability

kpis.name: Sales Growth 2025
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year change in total sales in 2025
kpis.description: Sales in 2025 declined 3 to 5% versus 2024, primarily due to decreased new pool construction (reduction from 62,000 to 60,000 units) driven by consumer discretionary spending caution and elevated financing costs
kpis.signal: Indicator of market demand and economic conditions

kpis.name: New Pool Construction Units 2025
kpis.explanation: Estimated number of new in-ground swimming pool units constructed in 2025
kpis.description: In-ground swimming pool construction units declined from 62,000 in 2024 to approximately 60,000 in 2025, reflecting consumer caution amid elevated financing rates
kpis.signal: Indicator of discretionary consumer spending capacity

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The market is fragmented with numerous competing distributors. The company faces increased competition for market share from pool and landscape product distributors.

risks.title: Economic Sensitivity
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily exposed to macroeconomic fluctuations, particularly shifts in mortgage rates, consumer confidence and existing home sales, which directly affect pool and landscape product demand.

risks.title: Inflation and Rising Costs
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to product cost inflation and trade tariffs. In 2025, cost inflation reached 2 to 3%, including 1% related to US tariffs.

risks.title: Supplier Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on numerous manufacturers to source distributed products. Supply disruptions or quality issues could impair the ability to serve customers.

risks.title: Technology and Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company uses technology to manage operations, mobile applications (Regal and E-Z Clor) and customer relationships. Risks include technical outages and data security.

ai_positioning.summary: Pool Corporation does not reference artificial intelligence or machine learning in its annual 10-K report. The company focuses on its role as a distributor of swimming pool and landscape products, with no mention of AI technologies.
